report_name: LockBit 5.0 Ransomware Claims Attack on Dutch Firm KALA Health

threat_actors.name: LockBit
threat_actors.description: A prolific ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) operation that provides its affiliates with the tools and infrastructure to conduct attacks. The group claimed responsibility for the attack on KALA Health using its LockBit 5.0 variant and posted the claim on its data leak site.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: As part of a double extortion attack model, the LockBit group exfiltrated sensitive data from KALA Health's network before encrypting files.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The LockBit 5.0 ransomware was used to encrypt files on KALA Health's network to cause operational disruption and extort a ransom.

malware.name: LockBit
malware.description: The LockBit 5.0 ransomware variant was used to encrypt files on the KALA Health network and exfiltrate data as part of a double extortion attack.

identities.name: KALA Health
identities.description: A Netherlands-based international manufacturer and distributor of nutraceutical health products targeted by the LockBit 5.0 ransomware group.

infrastructure.name: LockBit Data Leak Site
infrastructure.description: The data leak site used by the LockBit ransomware group to publish victim names and threaten the release of exfiltrated data.
